design: Chestnut squirrel father, mid-30s; warm sly half-lidded eyes; relaxed leaning pose; subtly broader shoulders.
profile_layout: Dedicated bust derived from full-body reference; no post or hands; identical character design; 2px padding on logical 64px canvas.
rendering: Profile native logical size 64x64; 128x128 is exact 2x nearest neighbor. Full body 128x192. Alpha strictly 0 or 255. Use image-rendering: pixelated.
scope: Only visual assets. No behavior or dialogue changes.
source: Built-in image generation, followed by deterministic alpha and pixel export.

profile_default.design: Neutral honest warm face, eyes comfortably open; same chestnut squirrel and outfit (user-approved 2026-10-09).
profile_default.export: Master 1254x1254 RGBA -> 56x58 logical bust (cell majority, thin dark lines kept when >=30% of a cell), placed at (4,3) on 64x64, alpha 0/255; 128 = exact 2x nearest; speaker128 = 128 crop (10,0,126,116) nearest-scaled to 128 (same framing as before).

profile_alt_sly.note: Previous half-lidded sly profile, kept as a separate expression. Not wired to any line.

finger_warm.export: 기본 정직한 프로필과 같은 원본 상자(49,27,1221,1236)→56x58 논리, (4,3)에 배치. 손 영역(x<28,y>=30)만 2프레임에서 가져와 얼굴·몸 고정
finger_warm.use: 결정적 대사·짚어 말하는 줄의 화자 초상에서 주먹→검지

profile_v6_matched.approved: 2026-10-10 사용자 '아빠는 좋아' 채택(dadol-profile-daram-matched-v2.png). 인물 프로필·대화 화자 프사·작은 얼굴을 이 한 장으로 통일, 포즈·손가락 프레임 연결 해제
profile_v6_matched.export: Master 1254x1254 RGBA -> 64x64 logical (cell majority, dark lines kept when >=30% of a cell, alpha 0/255); 128 and speaker128 = exact 2x nearest. Previous default (v5 default-smile) kept as father-v5-default-smile-*.
